A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

all 6D SCFs can be obtained by a combination of three operations: (a) orbifolding by a discrete subgroup of SU(2), (b) decorating curves with E-string theories and (c) decorating curves with a non-minimal gauge algebra.

all (2, 2) and (1, 1) 6D SCF Ts are obtained by compactifying F-theory on an elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau threefold, which has an ADE singularity along a divisor and possibly other gauge algebras on the curves in the base.

all (1, 1) 6D SCF Ts are given by the following data: (1) a 7-brane configuration in the base; (2) an ADE singularity at the tip of the 7-brane; (3) a set of curves in the base, each of which carries a gauge symmetry; (4) a number of E-strings, and their locations in the base.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 6D SCTFs are all built from a finite number of building blocks.
all 6D SCFs can be obtained by a simple procedure of “gluing” minimal theories along curves.
the minimal 6DsCFTs are the ones that can be constructed as orbifolds of a free hypermultiplet in ℂ2, which is the 6D version of the familiar ADE constructions for 4D SCFTs.
